4th Period.workingNow: Polishing your CSS-styled page and checking it against the style checklist before Sunday.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your About Me page with an external CSS stylesheet linked — custom fonts/colors, class/ID selectors, padding/margin, and an organized layout — pushed and ready to submit Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can check my styled page against the requirements so that it's ready to turn in Sunday night.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: You do: checklist review — stylesheet linked, selectors, spacing, layout (10 min)
Commit + push your styled page (10 min)
Exit Ticket: describe your favorite style change and why (10 min)
4th Period.connections: You've gone super slow through CSS this week — one topic a day. Today everything comes together: check your page against the full list, fix what's missing, and push your final styled page, ready to turn in Sunday night.

6th Period.workingNow: Finalizing your platformer plan and presenting it to another group for feedback.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A group platformer game plan (character states, at least one obstacle/enemy state, and a labeled level sketch) created in groups of four.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can present my group's platformer plan so that another group can give us feedback before we start building.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.10 — Use flowcharts and/or pseudocode to design solutions to complex problems.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: You do: as a group, finalize your character, obstacle states, and level sketch (20 min)
Group swap: present your plan to another group for feedback (15 min)
Apply one piece of feedback to your plan (7 min)
Exit Ticket: what's one change you made from feedback? (3 min)
6th Period.connections: You've spent all week planning — character states, obstacles, and a level layout. Today you finalize it and get feedback from another group, so next week when we start building in Game Lab, your group already has a solid plan to follow.
